message: 見えないもの

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Demon Lord, whip us up some breakfast already. Yours truly is starving here」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh right, today's Sunday, isn't it. No wonder Nanaka isn't coming to pick me up」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez... hurry up and wolf down some grub, then go wander around outside」

name: Paqy
message: 「If a guy who just got shot down in flames stays cooped up alone in his room, his mind's gonna rot」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, you're right. It's just like you say, Paqy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Damn straight! Go for a stroll up to the overlook, take a jog around Ryuusei Town, do some people-watching in the Shiokumi Shopping District--」

name: Synn
message: 「Check if 'Ponpoko' still has any usable heaters, go fishing off the jetty at Tsukinowo Park, or pick wild mountain vegetables in the sacred grove at Asukai Shrine」

name: Paqy
message: 「Your ideas are so painfully domestic it's making me wanna cry」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, once it's decided, let's head out right away」

name: Synn
message: 「Since we're passing right by, we might as well stop and make a wish」

name: Paqy
message: 「Fine by me, but do ya even have any offering money?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-If I pray with genuine sincerity, shouldn't that be enough? You know how they say smiles are zero yen」

name: Synn
message: 「*Clap, clap*...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Hmm, what a dilemma. What should I even wish for?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You didn't even think about it first?! Just wish for whatever pops straight into your head. That's your true feelings, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, in that case...」
--Please let Misa find happiness--

name: Paqy
message: 「You've got a good look on your face, Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? I don't really think I do, though」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, it is just as the spirit says. It has been quite some time since I have met a worshipper bearing such a serene countenance」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha?! S-Shio-chan, when did you get here...」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmph, I managed to approach without being noticed. This too is the fruit of emulating my respected lord」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「Today, I have taken yet another step closer to the realm of mastery. Only 65,535 steps remain until I reach Sir Butler's level.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see. I'm rooting for you.」

name: Shio
message: 「By the way, Lord Synn. I was just about to take a short tea break--would you care to join me?」

name: Shio
message: 「Of course, I have sweets to go with the tea as well.」

name: Shio
message: 「Today, I was gifted some sweet potato yokan and pumpkin manju. I cannot possibly finish them all by myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sounds delicious, I'll gladly take you up on that.」

name: Shio
message: 「I am humbled.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're tryin' to imitate the butler with that line, aren't ya, but you're usin' it in the wrong place?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Feels like there's way too many sweets for tea...」

name: Shio
message: 「Gulp... Hah~ Tea truly is wonderful, it soothes the soul.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... Yeah, it's good!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bit late to ask, but don't you got any other way to describe it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Slurp... Yeah, it's deep!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Makes zero sense to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not flattering you, I'm saying it's genuinely good.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn, if Japanese tea is to your liking, I would be happy to brew it for you anytime...」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, however, you do have your elder sister, Lord Synn. Even my Japanese tea cannot hold a candle to her black tea.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Shio
message: 「Because if it is for your sake, Lord Synn, your elder sister would gladly brew black tea for you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa is...」

name: Synn
message: 「The black tea I brew tastes so awful that she only does it because she has no choice.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm? If she truly felt she had no choice in her heart, I do not believe she would brew it at all...」

name: Shio
message: 「Teatime is a relaxing occasion where one can catch a glimpse of my dear sister unguarded.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Whether it's teatime or not, Misa looks pretty much the same to me?」

name: Shio
message: 「That is because my dear sister has opened her heart to you, Sir Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「No way! When Misa's always challenging me to contests at every turn? That's proof she's keeping a line drawn between us.」

name: Shio
message: 「It is understandable that you would feel she is drawing a boundary, however...」

name: Shio
message: 「What my dear sister draws is not a straight line, but a circle.」

name: Shio
message: 「Its radius expands or shrinks depending on whom she interacts with... And you, Sir Synn, are most certainly included within that circle.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so? I don't really get it.」

name: Shio
message: 「Mm... So because you stand too close to my dear sister, you cannot perceive the circle itself.」

name: Shio
message: 「Not only while enjoying tea, lately my dear sister speaks of nothing but you, Sir Synn, at every opportunity.」

name: Shio
message: 「The sheer joy on her face is such that it lifts even my own spirits.」

name: Shio
message: 「Though if one points this out, she forces a scowl onto her face.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I can totally picture that.」

name: Shio
message: 「My word, perhaps my little lecture was rather meddlesome of me.」

name: Shio
message: 「...Um, while I am already speaking out of turn, may I ask one thing...」

name: Shio
message: 「Are you and my dear sister... d-d-d-d-dating?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat?! W-Why would you think that?」

name: Shio
message: 「I have never before witnessed my dear sister speak so candidly and earnestly about someone, radiating such unconcealed happiness.」

name: Shio
message: 「Somehow, it comes across clearly to me.」

name: Shio
message: 「Could what my dear sister feels be, well... what people call love...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan--」

name: Shio
message: 「Gasp?! Oh, no! Have I presumptuously spoken on my dear sister's behalf?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's fine. Knowing Misa, there's no way she thinks of me like that.」

name: Shio
message: 「Why do you assert that so firmly?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...」
The cheerful atmosphere Shio-chan's chattering had created turned awkward because of my careless slip of the tongue.
Should I really tell her the truth?
If it's Shio-chan, maybe I can confide in her... Yes, just like the bond between my childhood friend Nanaka and me, she has to know Misa inside and out.

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Synn...?」
Should I try telling her...?
No, I'd better not.
If someone tried to use Nanaka just for their own convenience, I'd definitely be furious. And if that person hadn't even put in any real effort themselves, I'd despise them all the more.
I haven't even put in any effort when it comes to Misa, let alone struggled desperately. What good would dragging Shio-chan into this do when I'm in such a pathetic state?

name: Sally
message: 「Heya! I'm here again today, Shio-chi!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, Lady Sally. I have grown weary of waiting for you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Do you two meet up often?」

name: Sally
message: 「Every single day! Wait, Prez is here too. Yoohoo!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm... hmm?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yippee! Some yummy-looking manjuu and some kinda sweet square thingies. Time to dig in~♪」
Whether the timing was good or bad, because Sally-chan popped out of nowhere, my conversation with Shio-chan ended up cut off mid-air.

name: Shio
message: 「That is forbidden!」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa-oa-oa. Oopsie-daisy, can't do that. That was my promise with Shio-chi.」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed! Please refrain from enjoying tea until after you have finished training with me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Training? Don't tell me you do it every day with Sally-chan as your opponent?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir!」

name: Shio
message: 「If I can land even a single blow upon Lady Sally, victory is mine.」

name: Sally
message: 「And if I keep dodging until time's up, I win and get all-you-can-eat tea snacks!」

name: Shio
message: 「Today shall be the day I strike you!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, naginata brat. Tracing back those words of yours, does that mean you haven't landed a single hit so far?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh...! As long as I win before Re-Crea arrives, that is sufficient!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Didn't you literally just say 'today shall be the day'?!」

name: Shio
message: 「...Hmph, secular folk always fuss over such trivial matters.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, I have no clue what's going on anymore...」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? Re-crea? What was that again? Was it something yummy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Re-crea' is a brand-new kind of potato made by crossbreeding plums and chestnuts, ya know」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, nice, so nice, I wanna eat it! Shio-chi, roast that up into a baked sweet potato for me tomorrow, pleeease♪」

name: Shio
message: 「Save such demands until after you have won today」

name: Synn
message: 「No, a potato like that doesn't even exis--」

name: Shio
message: 「Bow!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Welcome in! *Bow*」

name: Paqy
message: 「Did her part-time gig at the beef bowl joint make her think that's how you're supposed to bow? That naginata pipsqueak oughta just tell her already」

name: Synn
message: 「Not giving that away easily is what makes her Misa's little sister. She probably thinks it's her trump card」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pretty pathetic ace up her sleeve」

name: Shio
message: 「Gah, always, always darting around like a pest!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufu-no-fu, you're just way too slow, Shio-chi!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's too fast for me, I can't even follow the path of her blade」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't sweat it. Even my mighty eyes can't see a darn thing」

name: Shio
message: 「Grrrr, how impudent! Vanish like dew upon my naginata. Hah, yah!!」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, booo♪ *Afu*, *fwaaaawn*...」

name: Shio
message: 「Gnnnnnh!! What is the meaning of a huge yawn in the middle of a match!!」

name: Synn
message: 「She's whiffing every single strike. Was Sally always this strong?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She ain't particularly strong, is she? She hasn't even counterattacked once」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but it doesn't look like she's struggling to dodge either. She's totally relaxed」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, Shio-chi. I'm boooored, so let's chat!」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall lend no ear to such nonsense!」

name: Sally
message: 「You know, Boss's way of fighting is suuuper sloppy~」

name: Sally
message: 「So so I wouldn't get caught in the crossfire, I ended up only learning how to dodge」

name: Shio
message: 「I am not one to be deceived by Lady Sally's bluffing! Prepare yourself!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss's attacks kinda feel yellow. You're the same, Shio-chi~」

name: Shio
message: 「Whaaat did you say--?! That I shall grow as portly as him in the future!?」

name: Sally
message: 「That's not what I meant!」

name: Sally
message: 「It's not like I actually see a yellow color. But from hands and stuff, this invisible yellow light goes pyah and hits me」

name: Sally
message: 「And then, KA-BOOOOM! Before you even blink, that spot really gets attacked!」

name: Sally
message: 「From you, Shio-chi, something cold and pale blue comes out and hits me~ So it's totally obvious, pffft-pfft-pfft~」

name: Shio
message: 「I shall not be toyed with by such falsehoods! Hyaaah!!」
She's really giving it her all, Shio-chan...
I should head off to my magic training soon too.

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, I know you're in the middle of practice, but I'm heading out now. I'll come hang out again!」

name: Sally
message: 「Zzz, zzz, mumble-mumble... ugh, I can't eat another bite... zzzzz~」

name: Shio
message: 「Gaaah--! Why will none of them strike--!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You can do it~\s02」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let us call it a night here. The magic circle is still unstable, but there is no need to rush」

name: Synn
message: 「Good work tonight. Though, aren't we finishing earlier than last night?」

name: Melilot
message: 「...If we do not take proper breaks, that groper will come attacking again--」

name: Helena
message: 「Calling me a boob-groper, how meaaan!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I did not say that!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Truly, how are you even getting inside a barrier that ordinary people cannot perceive!?」

name: Helena
message: 「'Hmph, it's a miracle brought about by love'」

name: Helena
message: 「Chairwoman though I may be, I am still a frail woman. So terrified am I of Re-Crea that I cannot help seeking solace in the Boob Diet Building」

name: Melilot
message: 「There's no such building in the Human World!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, isn't it right here♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Tickle, tickle, tickle\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「N-Not this again...!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Uh, well...」

name: Paqy
message: 「C'mon, let's head back and get some shut-eye」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, good idea!」
